contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Product head Alex Benzer says Bluesky plans to add “communities” this year, smaller spaces to “go deeper and hang out with people who care about the same stuff”   —  They're set to launch sometime this year. They're set to launch sometime this year.
